Contraindicated.

Lisinopril is contraindicated in patients with a history of angioedema, including hereditary, idiopathic, or previous ACE inhibitor-related angioedema [lisinopril:contraindications:0]. Patients with a history of angioedema unrelated to ACE inhibitor therapy may also be at an increased risk of developing angioedema while receiving lisinopril [lisinopril:warnings_and_cautions:2].
